records.academicNote: Business bachelor, OR a non-business bachelor plus at least ONE of: satisfactory undergraduate Statistics; a passed financial reporting/accounting paper in a CPA examination; or two full-time post-qualification years in accounting. These alternatives are not cumulative and two years is not a universal requirement. Business background is preferred; experience adds weight; GMAT/GRE is considered if available.

The consulted admission section states a recognised bachelor/equivalent and English requirements without an additional subject, honours, numeric GPA, work-year or GMAT/GRE gate. This observation is not a guarantee that no further evidence will be requested. Minimum 30 credits and maximum 34 credits are curriculum load, not entry GPA.

Full-time study does not require work experience. Part-time study requires at least one full-time post-qualification work year. The form captures total years only and cannot confirm this timing/type; the part-time requirement remains a separate mandatory manual condition. GMAT/GRE is not required; a good result may strengthen an application.

Work experience adds weight and GMAT/GRE is highly recommended; neither is represented as a compulsory minimum year or score. Only the ordinary HKUST MSc is represented; any partner/dual qualification or international study option needs separate assessment.

GMAT/GRE is highly recommended. Relevant work/business experience adds weight for full-time applicants; two relevant full-time post-qualification years is PREFERRED for part-time applicants, not a compulsory minimum.

Ordinary MSc only. Business foundation preparation is assessed; promising students without business foundation training may be assigned MGMT 5983. Optional CEMS has additional business/related degree, satisfactory GMAT/GRE, two languages including English and no more than two full-time post-qualification work years. Those CEMS-only conditions are not universal MSc gates. CEMS exchange/internship and add-on qualification are not represented as a Hong Kong-only ordinary option. The catalogue labels September 2027 fall intake but explicitly starts with a summer foundation term; confirm actual attendance dates.
No minimum work experience is necessary. A GMAT result is considered if available, not mandatory. No programme-specific major or numeric GPA cutoff is established in the consulted section.

Ordinary 24-credit MSc only: bachelor average at least 3.0 on the original 4.0 scale. No conversion from another scale. IELTS 7.0 overall/5.5 each or dated TOEFL iBT 100/5 is distinct from the usual 6.5/80/4.5. An IELTS sub-score of 5.5 triggers LANG 5070 study. The optional Academic Research Concentration is normally two years full-time at HKD 255,000 and is NOT the ordinary HKD 170,000 option or a two-year part-time price. Restricted partner-nominated early admission and HKUST course transfer require separate evidence.

Declare exactly one concentration at application; double concentration is not allowed and changes require approval. TESL: IELTS 7.0 overall, Writing 7.0 and other components 5.5; old TOEFL iBT 100 with Writing 27, or new iBT 5 with Writing 5.5. TCSL: IELTS 6.5/5.5 each; old iBT 85 or new iBT 4.5. Each English branch also lists first-language English/English-medium bachelor alternatives. For TCSL, non-Chinese-first-language applicants without a Chinese-medium bachelor need HSK Level 5; Chinese-first-language OR Chinese-medium bachelor applicants need PSC Grade 2B. Chinese background is not an automatic test exemption. The current form has no concentration selection or per-component Writing threshold model; all branch checks remain mandatory manual conditions, not a generic English pass.

Chinese proficiency requires ONE of HSK Level 4, Chinese first language, or an institution-awarded Chinese-medium bachelor/completed Chinese-medium academic programme. Humanities/Social Science background receives priority, not an exclusive required major. Both English and Chinese proficiency matter; English waiver does not remove the Chinese condition.

Only the 24-credit MA is represented. The 15-credit PGD is not available for new admission and is not a separate master or cheaper MA route. The consulted admission section establishes general bachelor/equivalent and English conditions without another numeric GPA/subject/work-year gate. Earlier spring dates are not applied to this fall cohort.

The consulted admission section establishes general bachelor/equivalent and English requirements; no numeric entry GPA, mandatory prior arts degree or fixed work duration is inferred. Minimum 27 study credits is not an admission threshold.

Second-class honours bachelor is required. No specific required undergraduate subject or numeric entry GPA is established. Additional credits and recognition/transfer are assessed; a credit-transfer entrant still pays the full programme fee.

Engineering or Science bachelor is highly preferred; other fields with outstanding academic performance may be considered. This is not an engineering-only hard filter. GRE is considered if available. Evidence of initiative, such as innovative/entrepreneurial projects, is required; shortlisted applicants may be interviewed.

Bachelor in any field with second-class honours and at least three working years. Strong performance, especially in analytical courses, needs assessment. Total reported work duration is compared, but documentary recognition remains unresolved. Programme study credits and extra-course costs are not entry GPA.

Second-class honours bachelor is required. GMAT/GRE is encouraged, not mandatory. A statement of purpose must make the case for public-policy interest and motivation; relevant work/internships receive favourable consideration without a minimum year requirement. Selected applicants attend interviews.

Eight work years and a senior organisational position are required. The programme expressly exempts applicants from university English admission requirements; no standard IELTS/TOEFL gate is copied. Putonghua or English with Putonghua interpretation and bilingual materials are used. The catalogue describes a programme composed of HKUST residential modules and global field-trip study; mandatory attendance, possible exemption and exact 2027 destinations need confirmation. Hong Kong-only delivery remains unconfirmed, not silently accepted or definitively excluded. The 2027/28 catalogue gives 16–18 months and a 30-credit minimum; its structure mentions 30–34 credits. Exact cohort start/deadline is not established.

scope: Nineteen central catalogue bodies cover eighteen remaining retained parent IDs; two full MBA directory-route snapshots. All are partial observations. Ordinary MSc/MA/MPM/MPP/EMBA scope remains explicit, CEMS and GCS research options are not silently merged.

boundaries.ile: Concentration-specific English/Writing and Chinese HSK/PSC are mandatory manual checks; no generic automatic language pass.
boundaries.gcs: Only ordinary 24-credit FT/PT study offered; optional two-year FT research concentration HKD 255,000 explicitly separate.
boundaries.emba: Partial source facts recorded; Hong Kong-only delivery and exact cohort dates unconfirmed. English admission exemption is explicit.
boundaries.mba: The original grouped ID remains one parent; two routes and three mode options. International and Local HK/valid-visa category labels are not MSc local/non-local. FT local final date remains unknown; 2026 commencement is not reused. Only the two PT offerings have category contexts: the current schema requires a published final date for every category. FT International 13 May 2027 is retained as a labelled observation; FT local final remains unknown, so neither gets a fabricated universal date.

preservation: Prior 156 checked objects, thirteen routes, 64 contexts, three scope decisions, all directory listings, pilot IDs, workbook and historical research are unchanged.
